objective: Associate the brand with cultural unity and relevance.
businessContext: A celebrity-led film borrowed imagery associated with real protest movements.
strategy: Use a mass-culture symbol and celebrity to dramatize togetherness.
outcomes: The company withdrew the film and apologized after widespread criticism.
whatFailed: The execution trivialized serious social movements and lacked stakeholder legitimacy.
transferConditions: Only use social-issue narratives when the brand has credible actions and affected stakeholders shape the work.
nonTransferConditions: Do not use protest imagery as aesthetic shorthand for product-led harmony.

sources.title: Pepsi statement re: Pepsi Moments content
